verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operation feature, but the building blocks exist. Headless mode with JSON output supports scripting the agent across many items, and parallel subagents, worktree sessions and background tasks let work fan out concurrently. The multi-session dashboard tracks many sessions at once. Bulk processing is therefore achievable through scripting and orchestration rather than as a first-class capability. Missing for 10: a native batch/bulk operation command or workflow, documentation of multi-item or multi-file batch operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk use.
